LOC_GEM_PLANT_ROOM.LIGHT_EMERG: strip lights off, red-orange emergency lamps and small green indicator glints, deep shadow between the cabinets

LOC_GEM_TUNNEL.LONG: a long, straight underground service tunnel about two hundred metres long and six metres wide, smooth white-painted concrete walls, a grey epoxy floor with a pale guide stripe down the centre, one continuous line of LED light along the ceiling vanishing to a point, steel fire-shutter frames at intervals and small black dome cameras
LOC_GEM_TUNNEL.SHORT: a long straight white underground service tunnel, grey floor with a centre stripe, a single ceiling line of LED light vanishing to a point
LOC_GEM_TUNNEL.STATE_POLICE_LINE: a line of uniformed police officers standing shoulder to shoulder across the tunnel
LOC_GEM_TUNNEL.STATE_SHUTTER: a steel fire shutter half lowered across the tunnel
LOC_GEM_TUNNEL.LIGHT_NIGHT: the ceiling line of LED at half brightness, cool white, long soft reflections running down the floor
LOC_GEM_TUNNEL.LIGHT_EMERG: the ceiling line dead; battery emergency lamps every twenty metres casting cool white pools, a green exit glow, black gaps between

LOC_GEM_TUT_GALLERIES.LONG: a vast, dark modern museum hall with charcoal walls and a high black ceiling, lit only by glowing glass display cases holding gilded ancient treasures: golden shrines, chariots, jewellery, walking sticks and statues in long rows; a huge gilded wooden shrine stands in its own tall glass enclosure on the central axis, the polished stone floor reflecting every case
LOC_GEM_TUT_GALLERIES.SHORT: a vast dark museum hall of charcoal walls lit only by glowing glass cases of gilded ancient treasures, a huge gilded shrine on the axis
LOC_GEM_TUT_GALLERIES.STATE_CASES_SMASHED: two tall glass cases smashed open, glass shards scattered across the polished floor
LOC_GEM_TUT_GALLERIES.STATE_EMPTY_CASE: one small case standing open and empty on a pale plinth, a single spotlight on nothing
LOC_GEM_TUT_GALLERIES.STATE_SHABTI_CASE: before a tall glass case holding rank upon rank of small mummiform funerary figurines in wood and blue faience, hundreds of them in tight rows
LOC_GEM_TUT_GALLERIES.STATE_THRONE: at the foot of a gilded ancient throne in its own glass case, a low bench and the polished floor before it
LOC_GEM_TUT_GALLERIES.LIGHT_NIGHT: after hours: only the cases glow, warm gold light inside the glass, cool blue-black between them, deep reflections in the polished floor
LOC_GEM_TUT_GALLERIES.LIGHT_DAY: open hours: a soft cool overhead wash plus the warm case lights, even and clean
LOC_GEM_TUT_GALLERIES.LIGHT_EMERG: case lights dead; sparse cool emergency downlights, a green exit glow, gilded surfaces catching torch beams

LOC_GEM_ATRIUM.LONG: a colossal modern museum atrium of pale stone and glass, six storeys high, with a vast triangulated glass wall; at its centre, on a low plinth, stands an eleven-metre ancient red-granite statue of a striding king; a monumental staircase lined with ancient statues climbs away to one side, and through the glass the distant pyramids
LOC_GEM_ATRIUM.SHORT: a colossal six-storey museum atrium of pale stone and glass, an eleven-metre red-granite statue of a striding king at its centre
LOC_GEM_ATRIUM.AREA_GALA: set for a night gala: round tables with white cloths, a low stage and lectern at the statue's feet, guests in evening dress
LOC_GEM_ATRIUM.AREA_GARDEN: the floor around the statue's base covered in rows of sleeping adults on white mats under pale blankets, clear water carafes between them
LOC_GEM_ATRIUM.AREA_STAIRCASE: on the monumental staircase, ancient statues standing on every landing
LOC_GEM_ATRIUM.AREA_SERVICE_STAIRWELL: in a bare concrete service stairwell behind the atrium, steel handrails and painted landings
LOC_GEM_ATRIUM.LIGHT_GALA: warm gala light: low amber uplights on the statue, pools of soft warm light on the tables, the distant pyramids floodlit gold beyond the glass
LOC_GEM_ATRIUM.LIGHT_BLACKOUT: every light dead at once: near black, the pale shapes of the glass wall against the night, amber light-slits brightening one by one across the floor
LOC_GEM_ATRIUM.LIGHT_GARDEN: soft, shadowless white light as if through white fabric, low and calm, the statue pale and serene
LOC_GEM_ATRIUM.LIGHT_EMERG: sparse battery emergency downlights in cool white, a green exit glow, the statue a dark mass above
LOC_GEM_ATRIUM.LIGHT_MORNING: clear morning daylight flooding through the glass wall, cool and clean, dust motes in the beams, the pyramids sharp in the distance

LOC_GEM_BOAT_HALL.LONG: a long, dim, high exhibition hall built around a single ancient ship: a slender forty-three-metre cedar-wood vessel with a high curved prow and stern shaped like papyrus bundles, a deckhouse amidships and long oars laid along its sides, resting on a low steel cradle, with a raised walkway and glass balustrade running its full length
LOC_GEM_BOAT_HALL.SHORT: a long dim hall around a slender forty-three-metre ancient cedar ship with papyrus-shaped prow and stern, a raised walkway along its length
LOC_GEM_BOAT_HALL.LIGHT_NIGHT: warm spotlights raking the honey-brown cedar, the hall black around the ship, soft reflections in the glass balustrade
LOC_GEM_BOAT_HALL.LIGHT_EMERG: spotlights dead; only a green exit glow and torch beams sliding along the hull

LOC_GEM_LOADING_DOCK.LONG: a wide covered loading dock at the back of a huge modern museum, a row of tall roll-up steel doors above a raised concrete platform with black rubber bumpers, an oil-stained concrete yard, steel stair rails, tall lamp masts, and a perimeter fence with dark open desert beyond it
LOC_GEM_LOADING_DOCK.SHORT: a wide covered museum loading dock, tall roll-up steel doors over a raised concrete platform, an oil-stained yard and lamp masts
LOC_GEM_LOADING_DOCK.LIGHT_NIGHT: orange sodium light pooling from the lamp masts, hard black shadows between, the desert beyond the fence dark
LOC_GEM_LOADING_DOCK.LIGHT_BLACKOUT: lamp masts dead; lit only by a truck's headlights and torch beams, black beyond

LOC_GEM_ROOF.LONG: a high exterior terrace of pale stone paving on a vast modern museum, edged by a frameless glass balustrade, looking out across a wide sandy plain and the edge of a sprawling city to the three Giza pyramids two kilometres away on their desert plateau
LOC_GEM_ROOF.SHORT: a high pale-stone museum terrace with a glass balustrade, the three Giza pyramids two kilometres away across the plain
LOC_GEM_ROOF.LIGHT_DAWN: first light: the sun just below the horizon at frame left, a cool blue sky warming to pale gold, the pyramids' left faces catching faint rose light, haze over the city
LOC_GEM_ROOF.LIGHT_DAY: clear morning light, neutral-cool daylight, crisp distance, the pyramids sharp

LOC_NOUR_FLAT.LONG: a lived-in third-floor flat in an old 1950s Cairo apartment building, high ceilings, patterned cement floor tiles in faded ochre and grey, tall wooden shutters with peeling pale green paint, bookshelves crammed to the ceiling, a child's crayon drawings taped to a door, a dining table buried in papers serving as a desk
LOC_NOUR_FLAT.SHORT: a lived-in 1950s Cairo flat, high ceilings, patterned floor tiles, tall wooden shutters, crammed bookshelves, a paper-strewn table used as a desk
LOC_NOUR_FLAT.LIGHT_NIGHT: one warm desk lamp and the cold blue-white glow of a laptop screen on her face, scattered city lights through the shutter slats, a child's night-light glowing in a doorway
LOC_NOUR_FLAT.LIGHT_DAY: hard white Cairo daylight falling in stripes through half-closed shutters, dust in the air

LOC_CONTROL_ROOMS.LONG: a large modern infrastructure control room, a curved video wall of network diagrams and maps above tiered rows of operator desks with multiple monitors, grey carpet tiles, acoustic ceiling panels, a few operators in headsets; every screen displays abstract lines and blocks with no readable text
LOC_CONTROL_ROOMS.SHORT: a modern infrastructure control room, a curved video wall above tiered operator desks, every screen abstract lines with no readable text
LOC_CONTROL_ROOMS.AREA_GRID: the national grid dispatch room, its video wall a vast abstract network of glowing lines
LOC_CONTROL_ROOMS.AREA_DAM: a window behind the desks looking down into a vast dim turbine hall
LOC_CONTROL_ROOMS.AREA_CANAL: tall windows behind the desks overlooking a wide straight canal at night, the lights of a huge container ship gliding past
LOC_CONTROL_ROOMS.AREA_CABLE: a cold, narrow equipment hall of tall black server racks glittering with tiny status lights, thick bundled cables overhead
LOC_CONTROL_ROOMS.LIGHT_LIVE: bright blue-white screen light on faces, low ambient room light
LOC_CONTROL_ROOMS.LIGHT_DARK: screens dying one after another to black, the last faces lit by a single dimming monitor, then darkness
LOC_CONTROL_ROOMS.LIGHT_RELIGHT: screens flickering back on one by one, blue-white light returning to tired faces

LOC_CAIRO_FLYOVER.LONG: a long elevated urban flyover of grey concrete on tall round pillars, six lanes with concrete barriers and tall double-armed street lamps, curving between dense ten- and fifteen-storey apartment towers of concrete and red brick, their roofs crowded with satellite dishes and water tanks, a wide dark river glinting far below
LOC_CAIRO_FLYOVER.SHORT: a long elevated concrete flyover curving between dense concrete-and-red-brick apartment towers with satellite dishes, a dark river below
LOC_CAIRO_FLYOVER.AREA_STREET: at street level on a dense avenue beneath the flyover, shuttered shopfronts with dark unreadable signs, parked cars and tangled overhead cables
LOC_CAIRO_FLYOVER.LIGHT_BLACKOUT_ROLLING: the city going dark district by district: some blocks still glowing sodium orange, others already black, street lamps dying in sequence along the flyover, headlights the only constant
LOC_CAIRO_FLYOVER.LIGHT_BLACKOUT_FULL: total blackout: towers black against a starry sky, lit only by the truck's headlights, the white light bars of driverless pods and one thin red light line
LOC_CAIRO_FLYOVER.LIGHT_DAY: hazy neutral daylight, towers crisp, dense traffic

LOC_ARMY_TRUCK.LONG: the cargo bed of a military six-wheel cargo truck, sand-khaki steel sides, a faded canvas cover stretched over curved steel hoops, wooden bench seats along both sides, equipment boxes and jerricans strapped at the front, the rear flap tied open above the raised tailgate showing the road rushing away behind
LOC_ARMY_TRUCK.SHORT: the canvas-covered cargo bed of a sand-khaki military truck, wooden side benches, the rear flap open onto the road behind
LOC_ARMY_TRUCK.AREA_CAB: in the truck's cramped cab, a worn bench seat, a military radio handset on a coiled cord, a cracked windscreen onto the night road
LOC_ARMY_TRUCK.AREA_EXTERIOR: a sand-khaki six-wheel military cargo truck with a faded canvas cover, unmarked
LOC_ARMY_TRUCK.LIGHT_NIGHT: dark inside; passing headlights and dying street lamps sweep through the open back and over faces; a dim green dashboard glow in the cab

LOC_CORNICHE_DOCK.LONG: a river police dock on a city riverfront: a tall stone-faced embankment wall topped by an iron railing and palm trees, concrete steps down to a floating steel pontoon hung with black tyre fenders, old patrol launches moored alongside, a small guard hut, and across the wide dark river a line of tall hotel towers and a distant bridge
LOC_CORNICHE_DOCK.SHORT: a city river police dock, stone embankment and iron railing, concrete steps to a floating steel pontoon with tyre fenders and old launches
LOC_CORNICHE_DOCK.STATE_PHONES: mobile phones dropping into black water, their screens lighting up briefly as they sink
LOC_CORNICHE_DOCK.LIGHT_BLACKOUT: the city dark across the water, towers black, only a few fires and car headlights on the far bank, stars on the black river, a torch beam on the pontoon
LOC_CORNICHE_DOCK.LIGHT_NIGHT_LIT: the last sodium lamps along the embankment, orange ripples on black water

LOC_NILE.LONG: the wide Nile in Upper Egypt, broad slow water between low banks lined with date palms, tall sugar cane and small mud-brick and red-brick villages, sandbars and reedy islands with tamarisk trees midstream, and beyond the green strip the bare limestone cliffs of the desert edge
LOC_NILE.SHORT: the wide slow Nile between banks of date palms, sugar cane and brick villages, reedy islands midstream, desert cliffs beyond
LOC_NILE.STATE_FELUCCA_FIRE: far off on the dark water, a small sailing boat burning with no one aboard, its orange flames doubled in the reflection
LOC_NILE.AREA_ISLAND: moored under the trailing branches of tamarisk trees on a small river island, reeds and wet sand at the waterline
LOC_NILE.AREA_FISHING_GROUNDS: among small wooden fishing boats with nets and lanterns
LOC_NILE.AREA_WEST_BANK_SHALLOWS: at the reedy edge of the shallows on the west bank, mud, reeds and a farmer's small wooden boat
LOC_NILE.AREA_LUXOR: off Luxor, dark tourist cruise ships moored three abreast along the east bank, unlit
LOC_NILE.AREA_OPPOSITE_AMARNA: the east bank opening into a wide pale desert plain ringed by cliffs, white fabric sun-shades glinting far across the water
LOC_NILE.AREA_ANCIENT_1332: the ancient river with no modern structures, dense papyrus thickets at the banks, a long wooden barge with a tall cabin and torches gliding north
LOC_NILE.LIGHT_NIGHT: blackout night: no light on either bank, black water holding a dense field of stars, palms as black silhouettes, cold white drone pinpoints the only lights
LOC_NILE.LIGHT_DAWN: first light: mist lying on the water, the sky pale rose rising to cool blue, palms in silhouette, the river silver
LOC_NILE.LIGHT_DAY: clear morning, neutral-cool daylight, blue-grey water, crisp green banks
LOC_NILE.LIGHT_MIDDAY_HAZE: hard white midday sun, heat shimmer bending the far bank, a bleached sky
LOC_NILE.LIGHT_AFTERNOON_GOLD: long gold afternoon light, the low sun behind the west bank palms, glittering water

LOC_ASYUT_LOCK.LONG: a long, low concrete river barrage striding across the wide Nile on massive piers, steel gantries and sluice gates along its crest, and at one end a navigation lock: a deep straight chamber between sheer wet concrete walls fifteen metres high, closed by huge steel gates, water staining and iron ladders on its walls
LOC_ASYUT_LOCK.SHORT: a concrete Nile barrage with a navigation lock, a deep chamber between sheer wet concrete walls and huge steel gates
LOC_ASYUT_LOCK.STATE_FILLING: water churning white as the lock fills, the boat rising slowly up the wall
LOC_ASYUT_LOCK.LIGHT_AFTERNOON: long gold afternoon sun across the barrage, the lock chamber in deep blue shadow below a bright sky

LOC_KARNAK_RAM_AVENUE.LONG: a long processional avenue of weathered sandstone ram-headed sphinxes crouched on pedestals in two facing rows, leading to a colossal unfinished temple gateway of two massive sloping sandstone towers, over a hundred metres wide, its rough face never carved, palm trees and the dark town beyond
LOC_KARNAK_RAM_AVENUE.SHORT: an avenue of weathered sandstone ram-headed sphinxes in two rows leading to a colossal unfinished temple gateway of two sloping towers
LOC_KARNAK_RAM_AVENUE.AREA_SPHINX_AVENUE: on a long, straight processional avenue of weathered human-headed sphinxes on low pedestals in two facing rows, running away into the distance between low retaining walls and palms
LOC_KARNAK_RAM_AVENUE.AREA_CORNICHE_ROAD: on a wide, dead riverfront road, its street lamps dark, palms along a low parapet, the black river beyond
LOC_KARNAK_RAM_AVENUE.LIGHT_NIGHT: Luxor dark: the gateway lit hard white from below by a few drone floodlights, long black shadows of the rams across the paving, a starry sky
LOC_KARNAK_RAM_AVENUE.LIGHT_PROJECTION: the whole face of the gateway lit by a projected moving image, its warm white-gold light washing over the rams and the small figures below
LOC_KARNAK_RAM_AVENUE.LIGHT_DAY: hard sun on honey-coloured sandstone, deep shade under the rams

LOC_KARNAK_HYPOSTYLE.LONG: a vast ancient hall of colossal sandstone columns packed in dense rows, the central aisle flanked by twelve giant open-papyrus columns twenty-one metres high beneath fragments of stone roof and slotted clerestory windows, over a hundred shorter bud-capital columns receding on either side, every surface carved in deep weathered relief with traces of faded blue and red paint
LOC_KARNAK_HYPOSTYLE.SHORT: a vast ancient hall of colossal carved sandstone columns in dense rows, giant papyrus columns twenty-one metres high lining the central aisle
LOC_KARNAK_HYPOSTYLE.STATE_THREADS: hair-thin glinting threads strung between the columns at shin, waist and head height like a loom, catching the light
LOC_KARNAK_HYPOSTYLE.STATE_THREADS_CUT: a few threads hanging slack and broken between the columns
LOC_KARNAK_HYPOSTYLE.AREA_THIRD_PYLON: at the hall's east end, where the rough inner face of a massive sandstone gateway tower rises behind the last columns
LOC_KARNAK_HYPOSTYLE.AREA_NE_CORNER: in the hall's north-east corner among the shorter columns, fallen stone fragments on the floor
LOC_KARNAK_HYPOSTYLE.LIGHT_NIGHT: lit only by scattered drone floodlights far above, hard white shafts falling between the columns, deep black aisles, small red and amber machine lights moving in the dark
LOC_KARNAK_HYPOSTYLE.LIGHT_PROJECTION: warm white-gold light from a giant projection spilling in from the west across the column faces, shifting as the image moves
LOC_KARNAK_HYPOSTYLE.LIGHT_DAY: hard sun shafting through the gaps in the fallen roof, warm sandstone against deep cool shadow

LOC_KARNAK_NINTH_PYLON.LONG: a massive ancient sandstone temple gateway of two sloping towers, one tower opened from the top like a quarry, its core of thousands of small hand-cut carved blocks the size of suitcases exposed in layers; scaffolding and ramps descend its face, and on the ground beside it rows upon rows of small carved blocks lie laid out on the sand
LOC_KARNAK_NINTH_PYLON.SHORT: a massive ancient sandstone gateway opened from the top like a quarry, its core of small carved blocks exposed, blocks laid in rows
LOC_KARNAK_NINTH_PYLON.AREA_BLOCK_FIELD: in the open block field, thousands of small carved sandstone blocks laid face up in long rows on the sand, faded paint on some faces
LOC_KARNAK_NINTH_PYLON.AREA_PROCESSIONAL_WAY: along a stone-paved processional way between ruined courts, fallen blocks and empty statue bases on either side
LOC_KARNAK_NINTH_PYLON.LIGHT_NIGHT_WORK: harsh white work floods on stands around the gateway, a slow grid of drone lights sweeping the block field row by row, a black starry sky
LOC_KARNAK_NINTH_PYLON.LIGHT_DARK: almost no light: faint starlight and distant floodlight spill, faces and hands barely readable, the stone a dim grey

LOC_KARNAK_SACRED_LAKE.LONG: a large rectangular ancient sacred lake about one hundred and twenty by seventy-seven metres, its still dark water held by walls of fitted sandstone blocks with steps descending into it, ruined temple walls and gateways beyond, and a colossal granite scarab on a pedestal near one corner
LOC_KARNAK_SACRED_LAKE.SHORT: a large rectangular ancient sacred lake of still dark water in stone-block walls with steps, ruined temple gateways beyond
LOC_KARNAK_SACRED_LAKE.LIGHT_NIGHT: black mirror water reflecting the stars and the white drone lights sweeping above, the gateways in silhouette
LOC_KARNAK_SACRED_LAKE.LIGHT_PROJECTION: the distant projected figure reflected, trembling, in the black water

LOC_KARNAK_QUAY.LONG: a stone river landing below a city riverfront road: a sloping boat ramp and a long quay of fitted limestone blocks with iron mooring rings, a low parapet wall above it along the road, and beside the quay's edge the wide river running deep and black, dark cruise boats moored far along the bank
LOC_KARNAK_QUAY.SHORT: a long stone river quay with iron mooring rings below a parapet wall, a boat ramp, the wide river deep and black beside it
LOC_KARNAK_QUAY.STATE_TROLLEY_OVER: a low steel platform trolley tipping off the quay's edge into the black water with a heavy splash
LOC_KARNAK_QUAY.STATE_TROLLEY_LIP: a low steel platform trolley stopped with one wheel over the lip of the quay
LOC_KARNAK_QUAY.STATE_SINKING: a carved stone block sinking face down through dark green-black water, bubbles streaming upward
LOC_KARNAK_QUAY.LIGHT_NIGHT: blackout night: the quay lit only by a torch and the dim red lamp of a moored launch, faint white drone light far above, black water glinting with stars

LOC_WEST_BANK_FIELDS.LONG: flat irrigated farmland on the Nile's west bank below bare desert hills: narrow earth tracks between walls of tall sugar cane and fields of green clover, a small irrigation canal lined with reeds, a mud-brick pump house, date palms, and the pale limestone cliffs of the western mountain rising sharply beyond
LOC_WEST_BANK_FIELDS.SHORT: west-bank farmland of tall sugar cane and clover, earth tracks and a reedy canal, bare limestone cliffs rising beyond
LOC_WEST_BANK_FIELDS.LIGHT_NIGHT: starlight only, the cane black, the cliffs ahead a pale grey wall, a first thin line of blue on the eastern horizon behind
LOC_WEST_BANK_FIELDS.LIGHT_MORNING: hard low morning sun from the east, long shadows of the cane across the tracks, the cliffs glowing

LOC_VOK.LONG: a narrow, steep-sided desert valley of pale fractured limestone, its floor laid with paved paths and low dry-stone walls, dark rectangular tomb entrances cut into the cliff bases with steel gates and small stone porches, loose scree slopes rising to jagged ridges and a pyramid-shaped peak above
LOC_VOK.SHORT: a narrow pale limestone desert valley of paved paths and dark tomb entrances with steel gates, scree slopes rising to a pyramid-shaped peak
LOC_VOK.AREA_KIOSKS: at the valley mouth, past dark shuttered ticket kiosks and an empty shelter for electric visitor trams
LOC_VOK.AREA_RIDGE: on the rocky ridge line high above the valley floor
LOC_VOK.AREA_VALLEY_ROAD: on the winding asphalt road out of the valley between bare limestone hills
LOC_VOK.AREA_KV21: at a small, plain tomb entrance in a quiet side branch of the valley, rubble and a low stone wall around it
LOC_VOK.LIGHT_PREDAWN: deep blue pre-dawn light, the sky paling behind the eastern ridge, the valley floor still dark, the drill's pale dust plume faintly visible on the hillside
LOC_VOK.LIGHT_MORNING_GLARE: blinding morning glare: hard white sun on pale limestone, a bleached sky, sharp black shadows at the tomb mouths, heat already rising
LOC_VOK.LIGHT_SUNSET: warm low sun, the cliffs glowing gold, the valley floor in cool blue shadow
LOC_VOK.LIGHT_DAY: clear, calm daylight, soft and even, the cliffs pale gold against a blue sky, the valley quiet and empty

LOC_KV62_STAIR.LONG: a narrow rectangular stairwell cut straight down into the pale limestone floor of a desert valley, sixteen worn rock-cut steps descending to a dark doorway with a steel gate, a low dry-stone retaining wall around its rim, and above it the larger porch of another tomb cut into the cliff
LOC_KV62_STAIR.SHORT: a narrow stairwell of sixteen worn rock-cut steps descending into the valley floor to a dark gated doorway, a low stone wall around it
LOC_KV62_STAIR.LIGHT_PREDAWN: deep blue pre-dawn light at the top of the steps, the doorway below a black rectangle, a torch beam flicking on inside
LOC_KV62_STAIR.LIGHT_MORNING_GLARE: a blinding white rectangle of sky at the top of the steps, figures bursting up out of the dark into glare, dust swirling in the light

LOC_KV62_BURIAL_2033.LONG: a small rock-cut burial chamber about six by four metres, its walls painted on a golden-yellow ground with large flat figures, faded and freckled with small dark brown spots; on the far wall a priest in a leopard skin touches an adze to a wrapped royal figure; an empty quartzite sarcophagus under a glass top at the centre; a low wooden viewing platform with a rail
LOC_KV62_BURIAL_2033.SHORT: a small rock-cut burial chamber with faded golden-yellow painted walls freckled with dark spots, an empty quartzite sarcophagus under glass
LOC_KV62_BURIAL_2033.STATE_WALL_BROKEN: a ragged hole broken through the far painted wall at head height, begun at a painted eye, chunks of plaster and rubble on the floor, pale dust hanging in the air
LOC_KV62_BURIAL_2033.STATE_CODA: the far wall seamlessly conserved and the painted eye restored, fresh blue cornflowers laid on the sarcophagus glass
LOC_KV62_BURIAL_2033.STATE_CODA_CASE: in the foreground a glass climate case holding a linen-shrouded form on a tray of sand, only a thin gold seam at one wrist showing
LOC_KV62_BURIAL_2033.AREA_ANTECHAMBER: in the plain, undecorated rock-cut antechamber, about eight by three and a half metres, rough pale walls, a low glass climate case on a plinth, and through an opening in the far wall the painted golden-yellow burial chamber glowing beyond
LOC_KV62_BURIAL_2033.LIGHT_BLACKOUT: the tomb's lights dead; lit only by handheld torches and one red headlamp, hard white beams sweeping the painted walls, deep black beyond, warm bounce off the yellow ground
LOC_KV62_BURIAL_2033.LIGHT_EMERG: a single battery work lamp standing on the floor, harsh white light from below throwing tall shadows up the paintings
LOC_KV62_BURIAL_2033.LIGHT_SUNSET: the tomb lights on, low and warm, a faint gold glow of sunset reflected down the entrance corridor, calm and quiet

LOC_KV62_NORTH_CORRIDOR.LONG: a narrow rock-cut corridor about two metres wide and two metres high, sloping gently down into darkness, its rough pale limestone walls scarred with ancient chisel marks and flint nodules, undecorated; the first stretch packed floor to ceiling with limestone rubble and mortar, half dug out by hand, dust hanging in the air
LOC_KV62_NORTH_CORRIDOR.SHORT: a narrow undecorated rock-cut corridor two metres wide, rough chisel-marked pale limestone, half-cleared of packed rubble, dust in the air
LOC_KV62_NORTH_CORRIDOR.LIGHT_TORCH: lit only by head torches and handheld torches: narrow white beams full of dust, hard falloff to black
LOC_KV62_NORTH_CORRIDOR.LIGHT_DRILL: fine dust sifting from the ceiling with each grinding pulse from above, the torch beams thick with it

LOC_KV62_HEART_CHAMBER.LONG: a small rock-cut chamber about four by three metres with a low ceiling, its walls covered in a pale, blank skim of ancient gypsum plaster, cracked, dusty and faintly uneven; at the centre of the far wall a square niche at chest height with a mud-plaster ledge; the air thick and still, fine dust on every surface
LOC_KV62_HEART_CHAMBER.SHORT: a small low rock-cut chamber, its walls under a blank cracked skim of pale ancient plaster, a square niche in the far wall
LOC_KV62_HEART_CHAMBER.STATE_BORE: a neat round hole 60 centimetres across in the chamber ceiling, pale dust raining from it
LOC_KV62_HEART_CHAMBER.STATE_COLLAPSE: chunks of plaster and rock falling from around the widened hole in the ceiling, dust billowing
LOC_KV62_HEART_CHAMBER.LIGHT_TORCH: white head-torch beams and handheld torches, hard falloff to black, dust motes turning in the beams
LOC_KV62_HEART_CHAMBER.LIGHT_RED: the whole chamber flooded deep red by a single red headlamp, every other light off, faces barely visible
LOC_KV62_HEART_CHAMBER.LIGHT_GLOW: in darkness, a warm amber-gold glow spilling through fabric at chest height, the only light on the faces around it

LOC_LUXOR_RAIL_YARD.LONG: a dusty provincial railway yard, a fan of parallel tracks on brown ballast, rusting goods wagons and faded passenger coaches on sidings, a long open-sided maintenance shed of steel posts and corrugated roofing, oil drums, a diesel fuel tank on stilts, date palms, and pale hills hazy in the distance
LOC_LUXOR_RAIL_YARD.SHORT: a dusty provincial railway yard of parallel tracks, rusting wagons and faded coaches on sidings, an open-sided corrugated maintenance shed
LOC_LUXOR_RAIL_YARD.AREA_INSPECTION_PIT: down in a narrow concrete inspection pit beneath a dead modern trainset inside the shed, oil-black walls, the train's underside just overhead, blades of hard daylight at the pit's ends
LOC_LUXOR_RAIL_YARD.AREA_ENGINE_ROOM: inside the hot, cramped engine room of an old diesel locomotive, a huge grimy engine block, pipes and valves, an oily steel grating floor, daylight through a grimy porthole
LOC_LUXOR_RAIL_YARD.LIGHT_DAY: hard midday sun, a bleached sky, deep black shade under the shed and between the wagons, heat shimmer over the rails
LOC_LUXOR_RAIL_YARD.LIGHT_DUSK: warm light fading to blue at dusk, the sun gone behind the western hills, a locomotive headlamp flickering on

LOC_NIGHT_TRAIN.LONG: a single railway track running dead straight through a sea of tall sugar cane higher than a man on both sides, a narrow gravel embankment, telegraph poles leaning at intervals, an irrigation canal glinting alongside, dark mud-brick villages and palm clumps beyond the cane, a flat horizon under a vast sky
LOC_NIGHT_TRAIN.SHORT: a single straight railway track through tall sugar cane higher than a man on both sides, leaning telegraph poles, a flat horizon
LOC_NIGHT_TRAIN.AREA_COACH_INTERIOR: inside a dark, rattling 1970s passenger coach, worn green vinyl bench seats, cracked square windows, cane whipping past outside
LOC_NIGHT_TRAIN.AREA_ROOF: on the swaying steel roof of the coach, vents and rivets, the cane a black blur below
LOC_NIGHT_TRAIN.AREA_COUPLING: at the heavy steel coupling between locomotive and coach, the sleepers a blur below
LOC_NIGHT_TRAIN.AREA_CAB: inside the locomotive's cramped cab, analogue gauges, a worn throttle lever, the headlamp beam ahead through the windscreen
LOC_NIGHT_TRAIN.AREA_ENGINE_ROOM: in the shaking, deafening engine room of the old locomotive, the engine block hammering, pipes and valves, a hand torch the only light
LOC_NIGHT_TRAIN.LIGHT_NIGHT: night with no lights anywhere but the locomotive's single blazing headlamp boring a white tunnel through the cane, and the white pinpoints of chasing drones
LOC_NIGHT_TRAIN.LIGHT_BLUE: a cloud of fine blue powder swirling in the headlamp beam and the drones' lights

LOC_DEIR_MAWAS.LONG: a small provincial railway station on a flat plain: a low platform beside a double track, a single-storey station building of ochre-washed plaster with arched windows and green shutters, a footbridge of rusting steel, a level crossing with dead barrier arms, cane fields and palms around, and far to the east a line of pale cliffs
LOC_DEIR_MAWAS.SHORT: a small provincial station on a flat plain, a low platform, an ochre single-storey building with arched windows, cane fields and distant cliffs
LOC_DEIR_MAWAS.STATE_DERAILED: the locomotive derailed and lying on its side in the cane beyond the platform, smoke and dust in its headlamp, the tracks strewn with white ceramic shards
LOC_DEIR_MAWAS.LIGHT_NIGHT: blackout night: the station dark, the locomotive's headlamp the only key light, and far to the east small carved shrines in the cliff face picked out white by floodlights

LOC_AMARNA_PLAIN_2033.LONG: a wide flat crescent of pale desert plain on the east bank of the Nile, enclosed by a long wall of sheer limestone cliffs cut by dry wadis; across it lie the low, sand-softened outlines of an ancient city's mud-brick walls and the vast rectangle of a ruined temple enclosure; far up on the cliff face, a tall round-topped stela is carved into the rock
LOC_AMARNA_PLAIN_2033.SHORT: a flat pale desert plain ringed by sheer limestone cliffs, the low sand-softened outlines of an ancient mud-brick city and a vast ruined temple enclosure
LOC_AMARNA_PLAIN_2033.AREA_GARDEN: inside the ruined temple enclosure, long rows of white fabric sun-shades on slim poles over thousands of sleeping adults on low cots, pale blankets drawn to the chest, laid across an ancient grid of low offering-table bases and column bases, blue cornflowers standing in fresh-turned sand between them
LOC_AMARNA_PLAIN_2033.AREA_STELA: at the foot of the cliffs below a tall round-topped stela carved into the rock face, flanked by weathered rock-cut statues
LOC_AMARNA_PLAIN_2033.AREA_FERRY: at the small ferry landing of a riverside village, date palms and mud-brick houses at the water
LOC_AMARNA_PLAIN_2033.LIGHT_MIDDAY: hard white midday sun, heat shimmer, a bleached sky, the white sun-shades blazing in the distance
LOC_AMARNA_PLAIN_2033.LIGHT_NIGHT: night: the sun-shades furled, the Garden lit soft white by tall lamp-masts, a glowing field in the dark plain, the stelae on the cliffs lit white by floodlights, a dense star field

LOC_QUARRY.LONG: an abandoned limestone quarry at the desert edge, tall stepped walls of chalk-white rock scored with parallel saw marks, spoil heaps and loose rubble, a rusting stone-cutting machine left on a bench, tyre tracks in white dust, and a small battered farm truck half hidden under a dusty tarpaulin
LOC_QUARRY.SHORT: an abandoned limestone quarry of chalk-white stepped walls scored with saw marks, rubble heaps, a battered farm truck under a tarpaulin
LOC_QUARRY.LIGHT_DAWN: cold blue dawn, the white walls pale grey, the first sun catching only their top edge
LOC_QUARRY.LIGHT_DAY: brutal white glare bouncing off the rock, figures pressed into thin strips of shade
LOC_QUARRY.LIGHT_SUNSET: the sun touching the western rim, the white walls turned deep orange, long blue shadows across the floor

LOC_DESERT_ROAD.LONG: a straight divided desert highway running to the horizon across flat stony desert, two lanes each way split by a low concrete barrier, tall dead lamp posts at intervals, gravel shoulders drifting with sand, a line of high-voltage pylons marching parallel, and nothing else but low dunes and sky
LOC_DESERT_ROAD.SHORT: a straight divided desert highway across flat stony desert, a low concrete median barrier, dead lamp posts and a line of power pylons
LOC_DESERT_ROAD.LIGHT_NIGHT: night, no lights anywhere but the truck's own headlights on the road and, far ahead on the horizon, a white glow of floodlights over the pyramids
LOC_DESERT_ROAD.LIGHT_DUSK: the last violet light of dusk in the west, the road grey, the pylons in silhouette

LOC_SAQQARA.LONG: a vast desert plateau of pale sand and rubble mounds at the edge of the Nile valley, dominated by an ancient stepped pyramid of six great stone tiers about sixty metres high, weathered and patched with restored masonry, behind a long enclosure wall of fine white limestone panelled with tall recessed niches
LOC_SAQQARA.SHORT: a desert plateau dominated by an ancient six-tiered stepped pyramid about sixty metres high behind a long white panelled limestone enclosure wall
LOC_SAQQARA.AREA_SERAPEUM_HEAD: in the open desert at the head of a rock-cut ramp descending underground, a steel winch frame on tracks standing over it
LOC_SAQQARA.AREA_TUNNEL_MOUTH: at a low rough-cut opening in a sand slope where an old service tunnel comes out into the desert
LOC_SAQQARA.LIGHT_SUNSET: the sun low in the west, the pyramid's steps glowing deep orange-gold with long blue shadows, the green edge of the Nile valley darkening to the east
LOC_SAQQARA.LIGHT_NIGHT: night: a few hard white floodlights on masts around a winch, the pyramid a dark stepped silhouette against a dense star field, no city glow anywhere on the horizon

LOC_SERAPEUM_LESSER.LONG: a low, older rock-cut catacomb passage half collapsed, its ceiling fallen in great slabs of fractured limestone that choke the way, timber props and steel shoring jammed under cracked rock, sand drifted over rubble, a narrow crawl-space between fallen blocks leading on into blackness
LOC_SERAPEUM_LESSER.SHORT: a low half-collapsed rock-cut catacomb passage choked with fallen limestone slabs, timber props and steel shoring, a narrow crawl-space beyond
LOC_SERAPEUM_LESSER.LIGHT_TORCH: lit only by head torches: white beams on fractured rock and drifting dust, hard black beyond

LOC_SERAPEUM_GREATER.LONG: a long, straight rock-cut underground gallery in pale limestone, its rough vaulted ceiling about five metres high, lined on both sides by deep side chambers, each holding a colossal box of dark polished granite with a massive lid, set down in a pit below the floor; a timber walkway with railings runs the gallery's length into darkness
LOC_SERAPEUM_GREATER.SHORT: a long rock-cut underground gallery lined with side chambers, each holding a colossal polished dark granite box sunk below the floor
LOC_SERAPEUM_GREATER.STATE_SAND_TRAP: a torrent of pale sand bursting from a hidden chamber in the wall and pouring across the floor
LOC_SERAPEUM_GREATER.STATE_DUST_FIGHT: the air thick with stone dust and drifting blue powder
LOC_SERAPEUM_GREATER.AREA_PIT: at the gallery's far end, where a freshly opened pit in the stone floor is ringed by work lights and a steel lifting frame
LOC_SERAPEUM_GREATER.AREA_RED_BOX: beside a colossal red granite box whose sides are panelled with faint columns of carved signs tinted green
LOC_SERAPEUM_GREATER.AREA_ENTRANCE_BOX: where a colossal granite box sits wedged across the old doorway, blocking it
LOC_SERAPEUM_GREATER.LIGHT_WORKLIGHTS: harsh white work lights on stands at the far end, the gallery falling away into black, dust hanging in the beams
LOC_SERAPEUM_GREATER.LIGHT_TORCH: only torch beams and small red and amber machine lights, the polished granite catching long reflections
LOC_SERAPEUM_GREATER.LIGHT_BLUE: a cloud of fine blue powder hanging in the torch beams between the granite boxes

LOC_SERAPEUM_SERVICE_TUNNEL.LONG: a narrower parallel rock-cut service tunnel of rough pale limestone, two worn grooves like old rails running along its floor, and halfway along it a colossal dark granite box abandoned in the passage, filling it almost wall to wall, leaving a gap just wide enough to squeeze past
LOC_SERAPEUM_SERVICE_TUNNEL.SHORT: a narrow rough rock-cut service tunnel with worn rail grooves in the floor, a colossal granite box abandoned in it, almost blocking the way
LOC_SERAPEUM_SERVICE_TUNNEL.LIGHT_TORCH: lit only by a swinging hand torch and a warm glow at chest height, long shadows along the grooves

LOC_GIZA_PLATEAU.LONG: the Giza plateau: three great pyramids of weathered limestone rising from a rocky desert plateau, the largest with its stepped courses exposed, the second still capped with smooth casing near its peak; below them a colossal carved lion with a human head crouches in a quarried enclosure, and a long ruined stone causeway climbs from it toward the second pyramid
LOC_GIZA_PLATEAU.SHORT: the Giza plateau: three great weathered pyramids above a rocky desert, a colossal human-headed lion in its quarried enclosure, a long ruined causeway
LOC_GIZA_PLATEAU.AREA_WALL_OF_CROW: seen from on top of a massive cyclopean wall of rough limestone blocks at the south edge of the plateau, looking north
LOC_GIZA_PLATEAU.AREA_CAUSEWAY: along a long ruined stone causeway climbing the plateau, its paving broken
LOC_GIZA_PLATEAU.AREA_SPHINX_WALL: on the rim of the quarried rock enclosure around the colossal human-headed lion
LOC_GIZA_PLATEAU.AREA_WESTERN_FIELD: among rows of low ruined stone tombs west of the largest pyramid
LOC_GIZA_PLATEAU.AREA_AERIAL: seen from high above at night, the three pyramids small on the dark plateau, the black unlit city pressing to its edge
LOC_GIZA_PLATEAU.LIGHT_MIDNIGHT_FORTRESS: midnight blackout: no city light on the horizon; the plateau ringed by hard white floodlights on masts, the pyramids lit from below, long black shadows across the sand, small drone lights drifting overhead

LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.LONG: a deep rock-cut shaft descending in three levels beneath the desert: rough limestone walls, steel ladders between landings, a middle hall of dark niches holding huge stone sarcophagi, and at the bottom a flooded chamber where black groundwater fills a channel around a central island bearing a stone coffin lid and four broken pillar stumps
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.SHORT: a flooded rock-cut chamber thirty metres underground, black water in a channel around a central island with a stone coffin lid and pillar stumps
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.STATE_W0: the water only in its channel around the island
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.STATE_W1: the walkway gone under, the black water waist-deep and boiling up from the pump's grille
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.STATE_W2: the water chest-deep at the ladder and a forearm below the lip of the small tunnel mouth, still rising
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.STATE_W3: the water stopped a hand's width below the lip of the small tunnel mouth, the pump silent
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.AREA_LEVEL_1: passing an empty rock-cut chamber on the way down the ladders
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.AREA_LEVEL_2: in the middle hall of the shaft, dark side niches, two holding huge dark stone sarcophagi
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.AREA_LEVEL_3: thirty metres down, a moat of black water ringing a rock island with a great sarcophagus lid among four pillar stubs
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.AREA_WALKWAY: a narrow steel walkway crossing the black moat to the island
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.AREA_PUMP: at the foot of the ladder, a big squat pump with its thick black hose snaking up the shaft, its grille low in the water
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.AREA_SIDE_TUNNEL: at the mouth of a tiny square tunnel forty centimetres wide cut into the north wall, knee-high above the water
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.AREA_CRAWLWAY: inside a cramped rough-hewn builders' crawlway barely higher than a crouching man, tool marks on every surface
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.LIGHT_TORCH: lit only by a single rifle torch and a warm amber glow at a young man's chest: a white beam on wet rock, green-black water, reflections rippling across the ceiling
LOC_OSIRIS_SHAFT.LIGHT_FLOOD: water churning and rising fast, spray in the torch beams, the light breaking into shards on the surface

LOC_GP_SUBTERRANEAN.LONG: an unfinished chamber cut deep in the bedrock beneath a pyramid, about fourteen by eight metres and four metres high, its ceiling roughly flat, its floor a jagged unfinished landscape of stepped ridges and trenches in raw grey-brown rock, a deep square pit in the eastern half ringed by an iron railing, a low blind passage leading off into black
LOC_GP_SUBTERRANEAN.SHORT: an unfinished bedrock chamber deep beneath a pyramid, a roughly flat ceiling, a jagged stepped rock floor and a railed pit
LOC_GP_SUBTERRANEAN.LIGHT_TORCH: lit only by head torches and a warm glow at chest height: white beams on raw rock, hard black beyond

LOC_GP_WELL_SHAFT.LONG: a cramped, irregular shaft about seventy centimetres square, dropping near-vertically through courses of masonry, then slanting steeply down through raw fissured bedrock, crude footholds cut in its sides, a small cave-like grotto opening off it partway down, fine grit trickling from far above
LOC_GP_WELL_SHAFT.SHORT: a cramped irregular shaft seventy centimetres square dropping steeply through masonry and fissured bedrock, crude footholds in its sides
LOC_GP_WELL_SHAFT.LIGHT_TORCH: a single head-torch beam straight up or down the shaft, the walls close and grey, everything beyond the beam black

LOC_GP_DESCENDING.LONG: a long, perfectly straight passage barely a metre wide and chest high, sloping steeply down at twenty-six degrees, first through smooth fitted limestone and then through raw bedrock, its narrow floor worn and gritty, a dead cable and lamp brackets along one wall, its far end a tiny black square
LOC_GP_DESCENDING.SHORT: a long straight passage a metre wide and chest high, sloping steeply down through fitted limestone into bedrock, its far end a black square
LOC_GP_DESCENDING.LIGHT_TORCH: lit by torch beams stabbing down the slope and small amber slits in the dark, the square tunnel receding in hard perspective

LOC_GP_MAMUN_TUNNEL.LONG: a rough tunnel hacked by hand through the solid limestone core of a pyramid, running straight into the dark and then turning sharply, its walls irregular, blackened with centuries of soot and polished smooth where hands have brushed them, a worn uneven floor, a modern steel handrail and dead lamp fittings, ending in a cramped cavity beside enormous granite blocks
LOC_GP_MAMUN_TUNNEL.SHORT: a rough hand-hacked tunnel through a pyramid's limestone core, soot-blackened irregular walls, a steel handrail and a worn floor
LOC_GP_MAMUN_TUNNEL.LIGHT_TORCH: torch beams and a red machine light moving in the dark, soot-black walls swallowing the light
LOC_GP_MAMUN_TUNNEL.LIGHT_DAWN_EXIT: grey-gold dawn light spilling in from the outer opening, dust glowing, the walls warming from black to brown

LOC_GP_GRAND_GALLERY.LONG: a steep, soaring ancient gallery of polished limestone rising at twenty-six degrees, about forty-seven metres long and eight and a half metres high, its walls stepping inward in seven corbelled courses to a narrow ceiling slot; low stone ramps with paired slots line each side of a central channel, covered by a modern wooden walkway with cleats and handrails
LOC_GP_GRAND_GALLERY.SHORT: a steep soaring corbelled limestone gallery rising at twenty-six degrees, eight and a half metres high, a wooden cleated walkway up its centre
LOC_GP_GRAND_GALLERY.STATE_STONE_SLID: at the top of the gallery, above the great step, a stone block slid back into the wall, a black opening behind it
LOC_GP_GRAND_GALLERY.STATE_ANCIENT_1332: without any modern walkway or fittings, its bare stone ramps and central channel lit by a single oil lamp carried up the slope
LOC_GP_GRAND_GALLERY.STATE_ANCIENT_1332_ARM: a long jointed bronze arm drawing back joint by joint into a low dark passage
LOC_GP_GRAND_GALLERY.LIGHT_SLITS: the gallery's lights dead; lit only by the small vertical amber slits of standing robots and a faint green glow from a carried casket, the corbelled walls lost in black
LOC_GP_GRAND_GALLERY.LIGHT_BLACKOUT_TORCH: the gallery's lights dead; torch beams slicing up the slope, the corbelled walls catching light in stepped bands, the top lost in black
LOC_GP_GRAND_GALLERY.LIGHT_HEART_GLOW: lit only by a warm amber-gold glow at chest height moving slowly up the slope
LOC_GP_GRAND_GALLERY.LIGHT_FIGHT: swinging torch beams, small red and amber machine lights, stone dust hanging in the air
LOC_GP_GRAND_GALLERY.LIGHT_DAWN_EXIT: soft grey-gold daylight seeping up from the lower passages, the gallery a dim warm grey
LOC_GP_GRAND_GALLERY.LIGHT_ANCIENT_1332: one oil lamp carried up the ramp, its warm gold stepping up the corbelled walls, deep shadow above and below

LOC_GP_QC_SHAFT.LONG: the inside of a tiny square stone shaft twenty centimetres across, climbing steeply into blackness, its smooth pale limestone walls running straight up, ending at a small polished limestone slab set across the shaft like a door, two corroded copper pins protruding from its face, a faint red ochre mark on the wall beside it
LOC_GP_QC_SHAFT.SHORT: inside a tiny square limestone shaft twenty centimetres across, ending at a small polished stone slab with two corroded copper pins
LOC_GP_QC_SHAFT.AREA_QUEENS_CHAMBER: in a bare limestone chamber about six metres square with a steeply gabled ceiling and a tall corbelled niche in one wall, a small square shaft opening in the south wall
LOC_GP_QC_SHAFT.AREA_BEHIND_DOOR: in a tiny cavity behind the slab, faint red ochre marks on the floor before a second stone slab
LOC_GP_QC_SHAFT.LIGHT_INCHWORM: lit only by a small ring of cool white LEDs low in the shaft, hard falloff into black, the copper glinting

LOC_GP_PASSAGE_ABOVE.LONG: a narrow, steep, never-seen passage climbing through the heart of a pyramid, walls of perfectly fitted pale limestone with hair-thin joints, a floor cut in shallow unworn steps, the air still and dry, the passage turning once before rising toward a low black opening above
LOC_GP_PASSAGE_ABOVE.SHORT: a narrow steep hidden passage of perfectly fitted pale limestone with hair-thin joints, shallow unworn steps rising to a black opening
LOC_GP_PASSAGE_ABOVE.LIGHT_HEART_GLOW: black but for a warm amber-gold heartbeat glow at chest height, lighting a metre of stone at a time

LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.LONG: a sealed, tall and narrow corbelled limestone hall hidden inside a pyramid, its walls stepping inward to a slit of ceiling far overhead, twenty-one tall empty niches receding along each side, opening at the far end into a square bay where an ancient black stone balance stands on a stepped plinth beside an upright glass slab, all in total darkness
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.SHORT: a sealed tall corbelled limestone hall inside a pyramid, two rows of tall empty niches leading to a black stone balance, in total darkness
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.STATE_C25: a milky frost in the last coil of its tail
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.STATE_C50: milky frost filling half its coils from the tail, the head still clear green
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.STATE_C75: three-quarters of its coils frosted milky white, only the head still green
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.STATE_C_MIST: the frost falling back, a last milky mist clinging to its tail
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.STATE_CLEAR: the frost running out of its coils like breath off a window, the green clear again
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.AREA_MOUTH: at the hall's near end, where a low square opening in the floor gives onto a steep passage below
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.AREA_BAY: in the square bay at the far end, the black balance on its stepped plinth, the glass slab to its right, a round stone iris in the floor before it
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.LIGHT_THREE_SOURCE: pure black; the only light comes from three sources: a warm amber-gold glow through yellow-green glass on the left, a cold silver-white plume of light in the right-hand pan, and one small vertical amber slit low on the left; the stone read only by rim light
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.LIGHT_PRE_HEART: pure black; only a cold silver-white plume of light in the right-hand pan and one small vertical amber slit low on the left, a faint green pulse at the balance's foot
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.LIGHT_VERDICT: a slow thread of warm amber light leaving a glass vessel in the left-hand pan and running into the tail of a coiled glass form at the balance's foot, light pouring down the upright glass slab
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.LIGHT_AMUN: the silver-white plume soft and steady, the amber slit dark, a calm faint green glow at the balance's foot
LOC_HALL_TWO_TRUTHS.LIGHT_ANCIENT_1332: black, cut only by one oil lamp set on the floor and the dim gold-green glow of a great gold-and-glass disk on a low wooden sledge, its bronze arms drawn in against its rim; once the vessel is placed, one faint green pulse from the left-hand pan; the niches in deep shadow

LOC_GP_NORTH_FACE.LONG: the north face of the Great Pyramid seen close: a vast slope of stepped, weathered limestone courses, each block about waist high, rising out of frame; high on the face a dark entrance sits beneath two pairs of enormous leaning limestone beams forming a chevron, and below it a rough hole leads in, with a stone platform and steps
LOC_GP_NORTH_FACE.SHORT: the stepped, weathered limestone north face of the Great Pyramid, a dark entrance high up beneath huge chevron beams, a rough hole below
LOC_GP_NORTH_FACE.STATE_RELAY: at the ragged lower hole, a shoebox-sized black relay unit on a three-legged mast, a dark cable running into the hole, a hair-fine glint of fibre on the stone beside it
LOC_GP_NORTH_FACE.STATE_EMBERS: embers of burning trucks glowing far off across the dark plateau
LOC_GP_NORTH_FACE.LIGHT_DAWN_0614: sunrise: a low gold sun just clearing the horizon at frame left, lighting the east face gold and drawing a thin gold line down the north-east corner, the north face itself in soft blue shadow, dust haze glowing gold at the left
LOC_GP_NORTH_FACE.LIGHT_NIGHT: floodlit from below by hard white floodlights, the face bleached and textured, the sky black and full of stars

LOC_FIRST_TIME.LONG: a vast green savannah where the Sahara is now: rolling grassland dotted with acacia trees, a wide shallow lake full of reeds and grazing hippos, herds on the far shore, low sandstone mesas softened by grass, a humid haze over everything and a huge pale sky, with no roads, walls or fields anywhere
LOC_FIRST_TIME.SHORT: a vast green prehistoric savannah with acacias, a reedy lake with hippos, grassy sandstone mesas and humid haze, no human structures
LOC_FIRST_TIME.AREA_DROWNED_COAST: far off, where the sea now lies, a low coast of pale stone towns beside calm water, softened by haze
LOC_FIRST_TIME.AREA_GARDEN_ROWS: adults asleep in long rows on the grass beneath acacia trees, empty wooden cradles and abandoned toys lying among them
LOC_FIRST_TIME.AREA_CORES: in a vast cavern of cut stone, nine enormous coiled glass forms lying in stone beds, glowing faint green
LOC_FIRST_TIME.AREA_MOUNTAIN: on a high rocky mountainside above the plain, a few shepherds in skins watching over their flocks
LOC_FIRST_TIME.AREA_RED_FIELDS: vast flat fields flooded with shallow red liquid stretching to the horizon
LOC_FIRST_TIME.AREA_T_PILLAR: a tall T-shaped stone pillar standing in a ring of rough stones, arms and hands carved in low relief down its sides, no face
LOC_FIRST_TIME.AREA_LIDS: colossal granite lids grinding shut over stone boxes in a dim quarry
LOC_FIRST_TIME.LIGHT_MORNING: soft humid green-gold morning light, haze on the water, lush saturated greens
LOC_FIRST_TIME.LIGHT_MOON_RED: night under a full moon, the flooded fields glowing dark crimson, silver light on the water's edge

LOC_ROBOT_HALF_MARATHON.LONG: a wide modern city boulevard on a spring morning, a race lane fenced off with plain white crowd barriers, spectators pressed behind them holding up phones, glass office towers and young street trees on both sides, a plain inflatable start arch without any lettering, and small awkward humanoid robots lined up at the start beside human handlers
LOC_ROBOT_HALF_MARATHON.SHORT: a wide modern city boulevard with a race lane behind plain white barriers, crowds with phones, glass towers, a blank start arch
LOC_ROBOT_HALF_MARATHON.LIGHT_ARCHIVE: flat bright overcast daylight, the look of 2020s handheld documentary news video shot on a long lens, slightly soft

LOC_DEWAR_VAULT.LONG: a windowless storage bay in a low desert-city building, rows of tall brushed stainless-steel cylindrical tanks taller than a man standing on a white-painted floor, insulated pipes overhead, frost furred around their filling ports, thin white vapour spilling to the floor
LOC_DEWAR_VAULT.SHORT: a windowless bay of tall brushed stainless-steel cryogenic tanks in rows, frost on their filling ports, white vapour spilling to the floor
LOC_DEWAR_VAULT.LIGHT_LIT: cool white overhead LED panels, soft reflections on the steel, the vapour glowing faintly
LOC_DEWAR_VAULT.LIGHT_EMERG: only amber emergency lamps and the soft glow of an amber light-slit moving between the tanks

LOC_PORT_WAREHOUSE.LONG: the vast interior of a harbour-side warehouse in a Japanese port city, a steel portal-frame roof high overhead with rows of skylights, long neat rows of folding cots under pale grey blankets laid between stacks of plain shipping containers on a concrete floor, and through the open loading doors a gantry crane cycling against the harbour sky, lifting nothing
LOC_PORT_WAREHOUSE.SHORT: a vast harbour warehouse in a Japanese port city, rows of folding cots between shipping containers, a gantry crane cycling outside
LOC_PORT_WAREHOUSE.AREA_GARDEN: sleeping adults lying on every cot, a few faceless care robots in sand-coloured knit moving slowly between the rows
LOC_PORT_WAREHOUSE.LIGHT_DAWN_GARDEN: soft white dawn light through the skylights, shadowless and calm, the cranes outside grey in mist
LOC_PORT_WAREHOUSE.LIGHT_NIGHT: dim cool night light, small amber light-slits dotted across the dark hall

LOC_DAWN_BOULEVARD.LONG: a wide multi-lane boulevard in a large eastern city at dawn gone utterly still, tall apartment towers and shuttered shopfronts on both sides, a planted central median of young trees, traffic signals on overhead gantries changing over empty lanes, the kerbs and gutters clean, not a single person or moving car in sight
LOC_DAWN_BOULEVARD.SHORT: a wide empty city boulevard at dawn, apartment towers, a planted median, traffic signals changing over empty lanes, no people
LOC_DAWN_BOULEVARD.STATE_SWEEPER: one faceless white robot sweeping the gutter with a broom, alone in the whole street
LOC_DAWN_BOULEVARD.LIGHT_DAWN: hazy pale dawn, soft grey-gold light, the traffic signals glowing red, then green, over the empty lanes

LOC_STADIUM_GARDEN.LONG: seen from high above, a huge modern football stadium whose pitch and running track are covered edge to edge by a precise grid of thousands of white mats with sleeping adults and pale fabric shades, tiny slow figures moving between the rows, the empty stands rising all around in concentric tiers
LOC_STADIUM_GARDEN.SHORT: an aerial of a huge stadium whose pitch is covered by a precise grid of thousands of white mats and pale shades, stands empty
LOC_STADIUM_GARDEN.LIGHT_DAY_GARDEN: soft overcast white daylight, shadowless and calm
LOC_STADIUM_GARDEN.LIGHT_DAWN_WAKING: first sun raking across the stands, long shadows over the grid

LOC_HOSPITAL_WAKING.LONG: a modern hospital maternity room, pale walls, a wide window, a raised bed with white sheets, a clear bassinet on a steel stand, a monitor dark on its arm, a nurse's chair, and a half-open door onto a quiet corridor where people are just beginning to stir
LOC_HOSPITAL_WAKING.SHORT: a modern hospital maternity room, pale walls, a wide window, a white bed and a clear bassinet on a steel stand
LOC_HOSPITAL_WAKING.LIGHT_MORNING: soft early-morning daylight through the wide window, warm and clean, the ceiling lights flickering back on

LOC_HEARING_ROOM.LONG: a formal modern hearing room with pale wood panelling, a raised curved bench for a panel facing a single witness table with a microphone and a glass of water, blank wooden nameplates along the bench, rows of public seating behind, and tall windows with pale blinds half drawn
LOC_HEARING_ROOM.SHORT: a formal pale-wood hearing room, a raised curved panel bench facing a lone witness table with a microphone and a glass of water
LOC_HEARING_ROOM.LIGHT_DAY: flat cool daylight through half-drawn blinds, even overhead light, quiet and formal

LOC_TITLES_KITCHEN.LONG: a compact modern apartment kitchen high in a residential tower at night, pale wood cabinets and a white stone counter, a neat pile of folded laundry with a child's white school shirt on top, a warm pendant lamp over the counter, and a dark window wall showing distant city lights far below
